hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A sequence query asks for the sum of elements within range [l, r] that are greater than or equal to a threshold.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Sort queries by threshold in descending order alongside sorted element values.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Insert elements into a prefix sum structure as threshold decreases, answering range sum queries in logarithmic time.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Offline threshold sorting with binary indexed tree updates takes O((n + q) log n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning each query range takes O(n * q) worst-case time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains Fenwick tree of size n + 1.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies offline query sorting with Fenwick tree range sum processing.
